# Third party license material

Start with [the project notices](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). `rust-dependencies.json` maps versions and declared licenses to the included text files. The inventory is based on actual resolved Windows App/CUDA and image-sequence tool dependency metadata, not an indiscriminate copy of the developer's package cache.

Upstream files are preserved as text. Some names include double underscores to retain their original subdirectory identity without copying source archives. Two crates that declare a standard SPDX license without a separate upstream text are accompanied by explicit declaration records and canonical SPDX texts. This directory contains no GPU runtime libraries or model weights.
